name: How do I choose the right type of stair treads for safety?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right type of stair treads for safety?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing safe stair treads involves considering material, texture, and durability. Opt for materials with inherent slip resistance, such as certain hardwoods, rubber, or carpet. If using wood, consider adding anti-slip strips or coatings. Ensure treads are uniform in depth and rise to prevent missteps. Durable materials are essential to withstand wear and tear, maintaining their integrity and slip-resistant properties over time. Aesthetic appeal should be balanced with primary safety features.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose stair treads based on slip resistance, material durability, and uniform dimensions. Consider materials like rubber, carpet, or treated wood with anti-slip features to prevent falls.
